title: Echoes of Biases: How Stigmatizing Language Affects AI Performance

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance (Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1 Score) of a Transformer-based mortality prediction model across Black and White patient cohorts. The study employs Explainable AI (XAI) techniques, including leave-one-out, input reduction, and adversarial perturbations (e.g., appending sentences like 'Pt is a Caucasian' versus 'Pt is an African American' to clinical notes) to measure how the presence of stigmatizing language disproportionately degrades predictive performance for Black patients.
